description:
Everything you need to pass the Claude Certified Architect (CCA-F) exam, Anthropic's first official certification, in one 25-minute guide. We break down all five exam domains, the question pool, and a four-week study plan that actually gets you ready.

The Claude Certified Architect Foundations (CCA-F) is Anthropic's first certification, and this is the fastest way to understand exactly what it tests and how to prepare. You will learn how the agent loop really works (stop_reason, tool_use, and tool_result), how CLAUDE.md and Claude Code configuration are graded, how the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and tool design show up on the exam, and the wrong-answer patterns that cost most candidates points.

Whether you are a developer, AI engineer, or solutions architect getting certified on Claude, this is your complete roadmap from zero to exam-ready.

📚 STUDY WITH PREPORATO
Six full practice exams, a 500-card flashcard deck, hands-on build tasks, and the complete four-week study plan are all on preporato.com:
👉 https://preporato.com/certificates/claude-certified-architect

⏱️ CHAPTERS
0:00  Intro & the CCA-F Exam Format (60 questions, 5 domains)
1:02  The Claude Ecosystem: API, Agent SDK, Claude Code, MCP
3:08  Domain 1: Agentic Architecture & Orchestration (27%)
6:09  Domain 2: Claude Code Configuration & Workflows (20%)
9:14  Domain 3: Prompt Engineering & Structured Output (20%)
12:43 Domain 4: Tool Design & MCP Integration (18%)
15:55 Domain 5: Context Management & Reliability (15%)
19:09 The Six Production Scenarios
20:29 Your 4-Week Study Plan
22:51 Common Wrong-Answer Patterns
24:13 Final Tips: Pass on Your First Try



📋 WHAT THE CCA-F EXAM COVERS
• Domain 1: Agentic Architecture & Orchestration (27%)
• Domain 2: Claude Code Configuration & Workflows (20%)
• Domain 3: Prompt Engineering & Structured Output (20%)
• Domain 4: Tool Design & MCP Integration (18%)
• Domain 5: Context Management & Reliability (15%)
Format: 60 questions, 120 minutes, 720/1000 to pass, online proctored via Anthropic Academy.
